name: Coordinator turn homes
responsibility: Remembers where each coordinator turn shows (the conversation shown when it started, the checkouts it gave work to) and which coordinator turn delegated each workhorse turn
description: A turn that delivered, steered or queued work, or whose delivery may have reached the workhorse, shows in the conversation of each workhorse it reached. A delegation the workhorse refused as busy or with an invalid body gave it nothing, and moves the turn nowhere. A turn that gave work to none shows in the conversation shown while it ran. A turn with no record shows in whatever conversation is shown. The timeline keeps only the turns of the shown conversation before it spends its budget. The tab session also subscribes a recorder to its workhorse operations. A delegate_to_workhorse event that names its workhorse turn records that turn against the coordinator turn that asked. A steer is never recorded, because it adds to a turn that the person or an earlier delegate started. The session keeps the 256 newest records, and the projection of the workhorse timeline marks a recorded turn with delegatedBy.
